title: NVRA § 8(k) (as added by SAVE Act § 2(f)) — removal of noncitizens from the rolls

process.name: rem
process.description: Lifecycle of one registrant's record under § 8(k). The statute names exactly two steps: receipt of documentation or verified information that the registrant is not a citizen, and removal 'at any time' upon that receipt. Notice and an opportunity to contest are NOT in the text; they are included as DUE_PROCESS_OVERLAY edges so that theorems can state, mechanically, that the statutory path to removal does not pass through them.

states.text: registrant on the official list of eligible voters
State has received documentation or verified information that the registrant is not a citizen (§ 8(k))
registrant notified of pending removal (overlay — not in text)
registrant has contested the information (overlay — not in text)
terminal: removed from the official list (§ 8(k), § 8(a)(3)(D))

events.text: State receives documentation or verified information of noncitizenship
